name: 笑红尘Ⅱ
english_name: Xiao Hong Chen II (Laughing at the Red Dust II)
english_description: Developed by Topkan Information Group (topkan.com), Xiao Hong Chen II shares its map — sects and cities including Huashan, Wudang, Emei, the Beggars' Sect, Dali, and Jingzhou — and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene almost verbatim with this collection's tybxjh and wlhd, marking it as another branch of the same "Tianya" code family. WASM testing initially judged the archive fully working, but deeper functional testing later corrected that assessment and uncovered real, previously undocumented bugs.
